notebooks.title: 自由释放与能量核验
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
import sympy as sp
from scipy.linalg import expm
from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp

cells.code:
m=250.;k=16000.;y0=.05;t=np.linspace(0,3,301)
for zeta in [0.,.3,1.,2.]:
    c=2*zeta*np.sqrt(m*k);A=np.array([[0.,1.],[-k/m,-c/m]])
    states=np.array([expm(A*tt)@np.array([y0,0.]) for tt in t])
    E=.5*m*states[:,1]**2+.5*k*states[:,0]**2
    print('zeta/c/wn/E0:',zeta,c,np.sqrt(k/m),E[0])
    for j in [100,300]:print('t/y/v/E/dissipation:',t[j],*states[j],E[j],c*states[j,1]**2)
    print('sample energy maximum/increase:',max(E),max(np.diff(E)))
y,v,c,k=sp.symbols('y v c k',real=True);m=sp.symbols('m',positive=True)
E=m*v*v/2+k*y*y/2
print('symbolic E derivative:',sp.simplify(sp.diff(E,y)*v+sp.diff(E,v)*(-c*v-k*y)/m))
print('force1000 equilibrium/base.05 equilibrium:',1000/16000,.05)

notebooks.title: 双质量受力与电路坐标
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
import sympy as sp
from scipy.linalg import expm
from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp

cells.code:
m1,m2,c,k,k1=sp.symbols('m1 m2 c k k1',positive=True)
x1,x2,v1,v2=sp.symbols('x1 x2 v1 v2',real=True)
M=sp.diag(m1,m2);D=sp.Matrix([[c,-c],[-c,c]]);K=sp.Matrix([[k1+k,-k],[-k,k]])
print('M/C/K:',M,D,K)
x=sp.Matrix([x1,x2]);v=sp.Matrix([v1,v2]);f=sp.Matrix([-k1*x1+k*(x2-x1)+c*(v2-v1),-k*(x2-x1)-c*(v2-v1)])
print('force sign residual:',sp.simplify(f+D*v+K*x))
energy=(v.T*M*v)[0]/2+k1*x1*x1/2+k*(x2-x1)**2/2
acc=M.inv()*f;edot=sum(sp.diff(energy,xx)*vv for xx,vv in zip(x,v))+sum(sp.diff(energy,vv)*aa for vv,aa in zip(v,acc))
print('two-mass dissipation:',sp.factor(edot))
R=sp.Integer(10);L=sp.Rational(1,2);C=sp.Rational(1,100)
print('RLC vC coefficients:',L*C,R*C,1,'charge coefficients:',L,R,1/C)
print('original exercise wn/zeta:',sp.sqrt(50/sp.Integer(2)),4/(2*sp.sqrt(2*50)))

notebooks.title: 电机降阶的三种电感
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
import sympy as sp
from scipy.linalg import expm
from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp

cells.code:
R=1.;J=.01;B=.1;K=.1;t=np.linspace(0,1,601);a=(B+K*K/R)/J;gain=K/(R*B+K*K)
reduced=gain*(1-np.exp(-a*t))
for L in [.001,.01,.1]:
    A=np.array([[-R/L,-K/L],[K/J,-B/J]]);u=np.array([1/L,0.])
    sol=solve_ivp(lambda tt,x:A@x+u,(0,1),[0.,0.],t_eval=t,method='DOP853',rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-12,max_step=.001)
    assert sol.success
    equilibrium=np.linalg.solve(-A,u)
    r1,r2=np.linalg.eigvals(A).astype(complex)
    wr=gain*(1+(r2*np.exp(r1*t)-r1*np.exp(r2*t))/(r1-r2))
    dw=gain*r1*r2*(np.exp(r1*t)-np.exp(r2*t))/(r1-r2)
    reference=np.column_stack([(J*dw+B*wr)/K,wr]).real
    assert np.max(abs(sol.y.T-reference))<1e-8
    print('L/poles/tau_e/tau_reduced:',L,np.linalg.eigvals(A),L/R,1/a)
    print('steady i/w/max sampled speed error:',equilibrium,np.max(abs(sol.y[1]-reduced)))
    print('at1s full/reduced speed/reference error:',sol.y[1,-1],reduced[-1],np.max(abs(sol.y.T-reference)))
print('initial full/reduced current:',0.,1/R,'initial full/reduced acceleration:',0.,K/(R*J))
s,L,R,J,B,Ke,Kt=sp.symbols('s L R J B Ke Kt')
print('full speed denominator:',sp.expand((L*s+R)*(J*s+B)+Ke*Kt))
print('reduced speed denominator:',R*J*s+R*B+Ke*Kt)

notebooks.title: 跨领域模型的单位与尺度
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
import sympy as sp
from scipy.linalg import expm
from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp

cells.code:
Ch,m,b,k,Ap,Kc,Kq,s=sp.symbols('Ch m b k Ap Kc Kq s',positive=True)
poly=sp.expand((Ch*s+Kc)*(m*s*s+b*s+k)+Ap*Ap*s)
print('hydraulic full coefficients:',[poly.coeff(s,j) for j in [3,2,1,0]])
print('incompressible divided coefficients:',m,b+Ap*Ap/Kc,k,'input gain:',Ap*Kq/Kc)
print('thermal tau/T100:',1000/10,20+60*np.exp(-100/(1000/10)))
S=1361.;albedo=.3;sig=5.67e-8;Carea=1e8;eps=1.
Te=(S*(1-albedo)/(4*eps*sig))**.25;tau=Carea/(4*eps*sig*Te**3)
print('radiation equilibrium/tau seconds/tau years:',Te,tau,tau/(365.25*86400))
print('epsilon drop1pct temperature change:',Te*((1/.99)**.25-1))
print('288K derivative timescale years, NOT equilibrium:',Carea/(4*sig*288**3)/(365.25*86400))

notebooks.title: 生态首次积分与SIS平衡
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
import sympy as sp
from scipy.linalg import expm
from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp

cells.code:
x,y,alpha,beta,gamma,delta=sp.symbols('x y alpha beta gamma delta',positive=True)
fx=alpha*x-beta*x*y;fy=delta*x*y-gamma*y
V=delta*x-gamma*sp.log(x)+beta*y-alpha*sp.log(y)
print('LV first integral derivative:',sp.simplify(sp.diff(V,x)*fx+sp.diff(V,y)*fy))
print('positive equilibrium:',gamma/delta,alpha/beta)
Jac=sp.Matrix([fx,fy]).jacobian([x,y]).subs({x:gamma/delta,y:alpha/beta})
print('equilibrium Jacobian/determinant:',Jac,sp.factor(Jac.det()))
for beta0 in [.1,.2]:print('beta/xstar/ystar/local frequency:',beta0,2/.2,1/beta0,np.sqrt(1*2))
N=10000.;rate=.0002;recovery=.1
print('SIS r/R0/Istar/f(N):',rate*N-recovery,rate*N/recovery,N-recovery/rate,rate*N*(N-N)-recovery*N)
for rate0 in [.000005,.00001,.0002]:print('SIS rate/initial growth/R0:',rate0,rate0*N-recovery,rate0*N/recovery)
